title: 阿木木·遗迹晨光
description: 保留幼小身形的阿木木静立宏大遗迹门洞，绿色绷带轮廓完整，晨光在身前铺成长条。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Amumu remains a very small childlike mummy with a large bandaged head, small dark eye openings, short limbs, and a compact fully wrapped body. Preserve the recognizable overlapping green cloth layers and a loose bandage end without changing him into an adult. Show clean intact wrapping, a thoughtful face, and no exposed remains, wounds, or frightening anatomical details.
art_direction.scene: He stands quietly at the center of a towering empty ruin doorway, looking toward a long rectangle of morning light on the floor. His small scale against the architecture conveys resolve without adult musculature or a battle pose. Use angular wax-crayon blocks for the stone and a sharp luminous edge along the green wrapping, leaving the background spacious and calm.
art_direction.palette: moss green, sandstone, deep blue shadow, pale gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
